notes.title: Mythrealm - Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Greetings Adventurers![/b]    

The time is close at hand! Early Access to the Mythrealm game will soon be possible for all those courageous enough to brave its mysteries! 
[/p][p]The Mythrealm Early Access Steam Release Date is confirmed for: 

[b]27th of October 2025 at 9:30am PST.   

[/b]Towards that end, we at Delta Video Games are super pleased to share with you the new Release Date Trailer, featuring gameplay from the EA Release version of the game. Check it out!   
[/p][previewyoutube="aiz9neSOvcA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Mythrealm in Early Access will bring the player out of the dungeons and into the land of Arloria to face monstrous foes and daring quests! New enemies to fight, new magic items, new spells and abilities and new secrets to discover!     

So get ready to embark on your adventure into the lands and underworld of Arloria and the magical Mythrealm beyond!    

[b]Wishlist the Game Today! Tell Your Friends who like fantasy RPGs and Souls Likes![/b] 

[b]Get the Game When it Lands on 27th October! [/b] 

We can't wait to welcome you to the Mythrealm!    

P.S. Check out the [b]No Time To Loot[/b] event on Steam - Active now!  Mythrealm is in that event! Check out their games. Cheers everyone! <3   

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45063983/sale/NoTimeToLootFestival2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45063983/sale/NoTimeToLootFestival2025[/url]         [/p]

notes.title: Mythrealm Demo - Updated to Version 1.10
notes.notes:
[p][b]Greetings adventurers into the Mythrealm![/b] 
[/p][p]Mythrealm Game Demo Version 1.10 is now live on Steam! 
[/p][p]This is a small update that features some quality of life improvements and bug fixes. 
[/p][p][b]-- Mythrealm Game Demo V1.10 - Change List --[/b] 
[/p][list][*][p]Agility 1 Archery Attack: Crippling Shot - Now always applies its 2x damage. Was previously sometimes only dealing 1x damage. [/p][/*][*][p]Attribute Points can no longer be lost (bugged) by assigning them, not confirming and closing the character sheet. Closing the character sheet with unconfirmed spent Attribute Points, now resets the Attribute points. [/p][/*][*][p] The Character Sheet + and - buttons have been improved to look more like buttons and be more easily readable / understandable as to their usage.[/p][/*][*][p] Ending Music has been added to the demo completion tunnel in level 1 to emphasize the completion of the demo. [/p][/*][*][p]The Skeleton Soldier miniboss in level 1 now has improved combat functionality and should prove a more challenging foe.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A bugged stone wall in level 1 climbing shaft has been fixed ( It no longer causes the character to spin out.) [/p][/*][*][p]Rock collisions after Goblin Town have been improved to stop the player slipping off / failing to climb some rocks. [/p][/*][*][p]A.I. navigation areas in Goblin Caverns and Goblin Town have been improved to prevent stuck Goblins.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p] [b]- Mythrealm Game Demo V1.10 -  Known Issues - [/b][/p][p]    [/p][list][*][p]On some rare occassions an arrow can get stuck in the bow, making the bow unable to fire.  We are investigating. If this occurs, please reload your last save.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]On some rare occassions the Shift Key can become unresponsive and also inventory input becomes unresponsive. We are investigatng. If this occurs, please reload your last save.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Some action inputs cannot currently be rebound in Keymapping options. We will fix this in a future update.  [/p][/*][/list][p]
We will continue to work on fixing any bugs we find or players report. Thanks for playing Mythrealm! 

Keep adventuring! :-)
[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: indie.io - Official Publisher Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey there! We at Delta Video Games have some fantastic news for you! 

We are delighted to announce that Delta Video Games [DVG] has forged a publishing partnership with the excellent indie video games publisher [b]Indie.Io![/b] From today onwards indie.io is the official publisher of Mythrealm and DVG's other sci-fi shooter game Assault On Proxima. 

This is really great news for Mythrealm, and we also hope, for the players! 

To learn more about indie.io and check out their wonderful library of games visit their publisher page on Steam:  

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio] indie.io's Steam Publisher Page. [/url]

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone. 

Delta Video Games is super happy to be working with indie.io as it will allow our small team to focus on what we do best - making our best games! 

We chose indie.io as the publisher ( And they chose us too! Thanks indie.io! ) of our games for a few core reasons: 
[list]
[*] We really admire indie.io's range of fun and cool indie games that include a mix of casual and serious games in a variety of genres from fantasy, to sci-fi, to post apocalyptic and more! We hope our games Mythrealm and Assault On Proxima will fit right into their amazing portfolio and reach gamers who love those styles! 

[*] indie.io gives us the creative freedom we need to follow our vision and make the games we believe in. They don't tell us what to make, they just help us make our games the best they can be and help our games reach a wider audience!  

[*] Perhaps a little known fact but indie.io also runs the Wiki Website, Wiki.GG! We're also partnering with Wiki.GG. to bring you the Mythrealm Wiki. If you like reading about games, check out Wiki.GG - it may have a page for your favourite game! 
[/list] 

[url=https://mythrealm.wiki.gg/wiki/Mythrealm_Wiki] Check out The Mythrealm Wiki! [/url]

[url=https://www.wiki.gg/] Check out Wiki.GG! [/url]

Striving forward into a mystical future it's gonna be great fun to partner with indie.io in bringing our games to you, the player. Over all it's a great advent for our small studio to work with such a cool publisher and it's really going to help us grow as a developer and bring you amazing and authentic games!  

Don’t forget to Wishlist Mythrealm, join our Discord community and follow us on social media to be notified of future announcements!  

Thanks for reading.  See you and our friends at indie.io in the Mythrealm! 

Happy Gaming and follow your dreams! 
Delta Video Games.
